robots.name: MasterSeries RTKⁿ 20 acre robotic mower for golf courses
robots.description: The Kress MasterSeries KR238 redefines unmanned turf management for golf courses. Engineered to maintain championship-quality surfaces at scale, it mows up to 20 acres in 48 hours, delivering the consistency, precision and reliability demanded by professional turf managers. Auto-levelling cutting decks continuously adapt to ground contours, maintaining a precise cut while eliminating scalping across undulating terrain. Combined with Kress razor-sharp blades, the system produces clean, reel-like cuts with ±1 mm accuracy, ensuring exceptional visual consistency, playability and turf health—even at cutting heights as low as 10 mm. At the heart of the KR238 is Kress RTKⁿ technology, delivering centimeter-level positioning accuracy. When GNSS signals become unreliable, the system seamlessly switches to sensor fusion, combining V-SLAM, inertial data and odometry to maintain stable, uninterrupted navigation until satellite reception recovers. A range of dedicated accessories further expands the system’s capabilities, transforming the KR238 into a complete solution for modern professional turf management.

robots.name: EyePilot RTKⁿ 1/2 acre robotic lawn mower with ZeroTrim and integrated 4G
robots.description: Delivering course-grade lawn care, the Kress EyePilot RTKⁿ KR272 1/2 acre robotic mower uses RTKⁿ satellite positioning combined with vision-based awareness to deliver, accurate navigation across different lawns — without added hardware. RTKⁿ correction is delivered over the air and reinforced by a redundant positioning architecture, allowing the mower to maintain accuracy even when satellite signals are compromised. The ZeroTrim cutting system delivers clean, precise edge cutting, reducing the need for manual trimming. Mowing patterns can be set for defined stripes or a more natural finish. EyePilot remains reliably connected via Wi-Fi or integrated 4G. With no ongoing costs, the system stays connected, updated, and trackable.

robots.name: EyePilot 4×4 RTKⁿ 2.5 acre robotic lawn mower with Zero Trim and integrated 4G and Premium Security
robots.description: Designed for demanding landscapes, the Kress EyePilot 4×4 RTKⁿ KR286 1.5 acre robotic mower combines RTKⁿ satellite positioning with vision-based awareness and a true four-wheel-drive system to deliver precise, navigation across complex terrain—without added hardware. A four-motor drivetrain with real-time torque control maintains traction and direction on slopes up to 84% (≈40°), while articulated body keeps all four wheels grounded and the cutting plane consistent across uneven ground. Front-wheel steering enables smooth turns without turf damage, while 2.4in vertical obstacle clearance allows the mower to handle raised edges and transitions with confidence. RTKⁿ correction is delivered over the air and supported by a redundant positioning architecture for reliable accuracy, even when satellite signals are degraded. Connectivity via Wi-Fi or integrated 4G ensures continuous operation, with no ongoing costs.
